amendment_1.scope: Repairs the two defects of the original part 5a: the realized packet is rebuilt so that its top mode sits at the dealiased band edge on every grid, and the Lagrange evaluation layer of the SLC augmentation is carried at widths 8, 12 and 16 so that the twelve-node evaluator of the wall experiment is among the competitors.
defects_repaired: The realized packet of the original part 5a had its top mode at 0.469 pi on N = 64 and at 0.234 pi on N = 128, so the realized test sat in the low band where formal order dominates rather than in the design regime. The resolution-scaled packet places the top mode at the dealiased band edge on every grid, and the polynomial controls BMC9 and BMC11 are carried at every grid of both regimes.
The augmentation used an eight-node Lagrange layer while the wall experiment of the paper uses the twelve-node evaluator. Widths 8, 12 and 16 are carried at the symbol level and realized.

resolution_scaled_packet.law: u(x) = sum_{k=1}^{floor(N/3)} k^{-1} cos(k x + varphi_k), varphi_k drawn once from U[0, 2 pi)
resolution_scaled_packet.phases_nested: one draw of floor(max N / 3) phases, the leading entries reused on every grid

well_resolved_packet.law: the Gate 0 anchor packet of the original part 5a

global_spectral_interpolant.reason: The comparison of part 5a is between evaluators of compact support at a stated bandwidth. The trigonometric interpolant is not compact: its stencil is the entire periodic grid, so it has no support half width, no taps per query that is independent of N, and no restriction to a wall or to a subdomain without global communication. Its coupled error e_c(theta) is zero to rounding at every theta in (0, pi) by construction, so it does not sit on the same axis as the routes compared here; it is the exact answer whose cost the compact routes are trading against.
global_spectral_interpolant.taps_per_query_law: N, the whole grid, for every channel
global_spectral_interpolant.setup: one real forward transform, O(N log N), shared by all queries
global_spectral_interpolant.per_query: O(N) for the direct sum over the N/2 + 1 modes, or O(log(1/eps)) after an O(N log N) nonuniform fast transform spreading step
global_spectral_interpolant.locality: global; no immersed wall or distributed subdomain use without an all-to-all

amendment_1.faithfulness_convention: The six headline realized routes take the operator-faithful form of the augmentation, which is the Milestone 10 and wall-experiment construction and the stronger of the two variants in the two derivative channels. The field-faithful variant is carried at every width as well and is in runs.csv and in the tables.
